name: getArticleDetail
description: Read-only published article by positive ID. Returns at most 2000 text characters with a canonical local source link and content hash. Hidden/deleted/nonexistent all return NOT_FOUND.

id.description: Positive integer article ID, at most 9007199254740991

name: searchArticles
description: Read-only literal keyword search in published article titles. Never reads drafts or deleted articles. Returns at most 5 bounded previews; not full-text or semantic search.

keyword.description: 1-80 characters; no %, _, backslash or control characters

name: searchProjects
description: Read-only literal keyword search in public project names. Never reads hidden or deleted projects. Returns at most 5 bounded previews.

keyword.description: 1-80 characters; no %, _, backslash or control characters

name: getProjectDetail
description: Read-only public project by positive ID. Returns at most 2000 text characters with a canonical local source link and content hash. Hidden/deleted/nonexistent all return NOT_FOUND.

id.description: Positive integer project ID, at most 9007199254740991
